authority.note: This packet frames required adversarial reviews; script generation never answers or decides them.

limitations: Evidence context is assembled mechanically and may include irrelevant rows; the reviewer must judge relevance.
A pending red-team prompt is not a judgment_review and cannot support an M6 decision.
No script-authored verdict or recommendation is permitted.
Priority weights allocate review attention only.
Later judgment must preserve Commander-first identity and bracket-specific context.

reviews.adversarial_challenge: Assume multiple permanent types are answered over several turns. Identify which strategic routes actually rebuild and which collapse after repeated removal.

value: Don't drift into generic Grixis artifacts or generic discard.
Don't add opponent-upkeep effects (The Rack, Bottomless Pit) that don't help on your turn (source cuts).

blueprint_failure_modes.description: No opponent at 3 life lost this turn: the trigger does nothing.

mitigations: Discard punishers make both branches cost something

blueprint_failure_modes.description: Value without a kill: games go long.

value.interaction: Strong: 13 interaction pieces including free counters and sweepers.
value.mana: Four-mana commander; fixing upgrades (City of Brass, Mana Confluence).
value.protection: Greaves, Boots, Padeem (artifact), Plaza of Heroes.

accepted_role.advances_plan: Davros is the repeatable value engine: Dalek every turn plus a card or a discard per qualifying opponent.
accepted_role.honest_note: Value-only engine with delayed payoff and opponent choice; no Spellbook combos. The deck is Bracket 4 mainly because of its Game Changers and premium interaction, not because Davros threatens fast wins.
